original.statement: KVStoreMesh is now enabled by default; clusters using external workloads must set a cluster name and ID before upgrading, or explicitly opt out of KVStoreMesh.

decision.reason: [ev-b62da9c1ceb5] says that, because KVStoreMesh is now enabled by default, clusters that use external workloads must have a Cluster name and ID specified before upgrading, or explicitly opt out of KVStoreMesh. That is a step the operator must take before the upgrade, so the migration family with change type migration-required fits. The name kvstoremesh-cluster-name-id is short kebab-case built only from the excerpt's own key words. It needs no component, because the text names no separate binary or chart.
